ideas.pitch: A compact conveyor belt prototype using a low-cost camera and edge AI to classify recyclable waste in real-time, built specifically for sorting facility automation.
ideas.title: EcoSort Edge: Smart Automated Waste Sorting Micro-Rig
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Energy & Sustainable Technologies domain with a physical prototype that can be demonstrated live, following the proven success pattern of working hardware demos.

ideas.pitch: A tabletop 3D machine vision camera setup that scans moving textile samples to instantly flag manufacturing anomalies and halt production.
ideas.title: VisionGuard: Industrial Fabric Defect Detection Rig
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses Smart Infrastructure & Digital Ecosystems with heavy industrial utility, replicating the complex sensing and immediate feedback loop that judges reward.

ideas.pitch: A waterproof floating sensor node measuring turbidity, temperature, and pH levels to predict water quality hazards via onboard machine learning.
ideas.title: AquaSense Mini: IoT Algal Bloom Early Warning Buoy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines IoT sensing with environmental protection, fitting squarely into Resilience & Emerging Technologies while demonstrating end-to-end data pipelines.

ideas.pitch: An edge diagnostic box that monitors industrial motor vibrations, detects anomalies using lightweight isolation forests, and triggers automated self-remediation routines.
ideas.title: AutoHeal IoT: Closed-Loop Sensor Diagnostic Unit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases genuinely hard engineering by implementing automated closed-loop operational workflows on constrained hardware within the Intelligent & Autonomous Systems domain.

ideas.pitch: A small tracked robotic rover that navigates unstructured terrain independently to map hazards and stream live telemetry back to an operations dashboard.
ideas.title: TerraPatrol: Autonomous Terrain Mapping Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an impressive, highly visible hardware demonstration that directly answers the 'Experience Innovation' theme by moving hardware ideas off paper into reality.
